sentences.text: For new retail and MSME term loans sanctioned on or after 1 October 2024 by a UCB, fees or charges not mentioned in the KFS cannot be charged to the borrower at any stage during the loan term without the borrower’s explicit consent.
The available facts do not include the sanction date, so I cannot confirm from the record whether this specific loan falls within that UCB rule’s stated scope.
